features.feature: Elongated rectangular pillow with rounded corners and a contoured profile: raised long sides around a lower central area.
Light gray cover with a dense, repeating raised hexagonal honeycomb texture.
Cover has visible stitched seams tracing the perimeter and contour.
In the uncovered view, the foam is turquoise-blue with orderly rows of small dark perforations.
The exposed foam has a solid turquoise-blue side wall without the top perforation pattern.
